rule: Use experiment_observation rows from yield/TLB/SDM for genotype-level models
reason: These are the biological experimental observations

rule: Exclude yield General Mean/Location Mean/CD/CV/statistic rows
reason: They are experiment summaries, not genotype observations

rule: Remove only exact duplicate later occurrences in clean layer

reason: Repeated identifiers may represent repeated source rows or distinct observations

rule: Validate genotype aliases before cross-document joining
reason: Avoid false joins caused by OCR/name variants

rule: Do not use inference/narrative conclusions as predictive features
reason: Can leak the target or post-experiment conclusion

rule: Keep source_page/source_section in every downstream dataset
Do not overwrite raw master while cleaning
